returns-mercedes-original-packaging.claim: makes undamaged original packaging a condition for returns.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.quote: Nur ungetragene Artikel in unbeschädigter Originalverpackung und ohne Gebrauchsspuren können retourniert werden.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.tr: Only unworn items in undamaged original packaging and without signs of use can be returned.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.law: The page expressly covers returns after withdrawal, yet states an unqualified original-packaging condition. For ordinary goods, missing or damaged original packaging does not itself remove the statutory right. Examination is allowed; any diminished-value claim depends on actual loss, unnecessary handling and the information required by BGB § 357a(1). The linked withdrawal notice correctly states that narrower diminished-value rule, so the finding concerns contradictory returns guidance, not an assertion that every Mercedes-Benz notice is wrong.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.example: Hypothetical: A consumer orders an ordinary, unpersonalised accessory online, opens its packaging to inspect it, and sends a clear withdrawal declaration within 14 days of receipt. The accessory remains undamaged, but the original packaging is unavailable. Assuming no statutory exception applies, the missing packaging alone does not justify refusing withdrawal. Any separate claim for actual lost value must meet the statutory conditions.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.context: The first paragraph says the page applies to a return following withdrawal or a warranty claim. The packaging condition is in the first bullet under the returns instructions. The separate footer-linked Widerrufsbelehrung correctly explains that only loss caused by handling beyond necessary examination is chargeable. The current homepage links both pages.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.scope: German consumer distance sales of ordinary goods, with timely withdrawal and no statutory exception. This is a discrepancy in published instructions; no actual refused return, consumer loss or intent was established. Defect remedies and voluntary additional returns are outside the finding.

versions.quote: Nur ungetragene Artikel in unbeschädigter Originalverpackung und ohne Gebrauchsspuren können retourniert werden.
versions.tr: Only unworn items in undamaged original packaging and without signs of use can be returned.

returns-shr-unopened-packaging.claim: requires consumer returns to be unopened and in their original packaging.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.quote: Die Ware muss sich im ungeöffneten, unbenutzten Originalzustand befinden und in der Originalverpackung an uns zurückgesendet werden.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.tr: The goods must be in their unopened, unused original condition and be sent back to us in their original packaging.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.law: This condition appears as a general requirement directly under the statutory 14-day right for private consumers. Ordinary goods can be opened and examined without losing that right. BGB § 357a(1) addresses any actual loss caused by unnecessary handling; it does not make unopened packaging a universal condition. The hygiene exception can apply to particular sealed goods, but cannot justify this general condition for ordinary products such as handbags.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.example: Hypothetical: A private customer orders an ordinary handbag online for personal use. She opens its packaging to inspect the bag, leaves it undamaged and unused, and declares withdrawal within 14 days of receipt. Assuming the bag is not personalised and no statutory exception applies, opening the packaging does not remove her right. Any alleged loss of value must satisfy BGB § 357a(1).
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.context: The policy separates section 1, Widerrufsrecht für Privatkunden (B2C), from section 3, voluntary handling of business-customer returns. The challenged sentence sits in section 1 beneath the stated 14-day right. Section 2 separately lists claimed exceptions. Linked AGB § 21 expressly recognises statutory consumer withdrawal and lists the specific hygiene and mixing exceptions. The shop currently lists ordinary handbags, alongside beauty products.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.scope: Timely statutory withdrawal by consumers buying ordinary physical goods online in Germany. The finding does not decide whether particular cosmetics, sealed hygiene goods or commercial purchases qualify. It concerns the general condition, rather than actual return handling, losses or intent.

versions.quote: Die Ware muss sich im ungeöffneten, unbenutzten Originalzustand befinden und in der Originalverpackung an uns zurückgesendet werden.
versions.tr: The goods must be in their unopened, unused original condition and be sent back to us in their original packaging.

returns-cwt-original-seal.claim: requires an intact original seal and original packaging for returns.
returns-cwt-original-seal.quote: Der Artikel muss sich in der Originalverpackung befinden und das Original Siegel muss unbeschädigt sein.
returns-cwt-original-seal.tr: The item must be in its original packaging and the original seal must be undamaged.
returns-cwt-original-seal.law: A normal product seal is not a general statutory exception. For ordinary vehicle parts bought by consumers at a distance, opening a package to inspect the goods does not by itself remove withdrawal. Article 14(2) and BGB § 357a(1) instead permit liability for qualifying actual loss of value from unnecessary handling. Specific exceptions for hygiene goods or sealed media do not cover ordinary vehicle parts merely because their packaging has a seal.
returns-cwt-original-seal.example: Hypothetical: A consumer orders a standard ignition coil for his own car online, opens its sealed carton only to inspect the part without installing it, then declares withdrawal within 14 days of receipt and returns it promptly. Assuming no statutory exception applies, the broken ordinary carton seal alone does not justify refusing withdrawal. Any separate lost-value claim requires the statutory conditions.
returns-cwt-original-seal.context: The live policy is titled Widerrufsrecht and describes a 14-day return right. The preceding sentence reserves a right to refuse returns if an article is removed from its packaging and the seal is cut; a later list allows only partial refunds where an original seal has been cut. The linked AGB direct online-product returns to this policy. The shop also links a separate withdrawal form but no second substantive statutory notice was found in the reviewed pages.
returns-cwt-original-seal.scope: Ordinary unpersonalised vehicle parts bought online for personal use by German consumers, with timely withdrawal. This does not address installation damage, value lost through use, dangerous-goods shipping or specific statutory exceptions. The page uses Rückgaberecht in the body beneath its Widerrufsrecht heading; the finding concerns the conditions presented in that statutory-facing policy, not an actual refusal.

versions.quote: Der Artikel muss sich in der Originalverpackung befinden und das Original Siegel muss unbeschädigt sein.
versions.tr: The item must be in its original packaging and the original seal must be undamaged.

returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.claim: excludes a duvet from statutory withdrawal simply because it labels the product a hygiene item.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.quote: Dieses Produkt ist im Best Nature Shop ein Hygieneartikel und daher vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.tr: This product is a hygiene item at Best Nature Shop and is therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.law: The statement applies to the product without requiring removal of any seal. BGB § 312g(2) no. 3, implementing Article 16(e), cannot exclude an otherwise eligible consumer’s unopened, still-sealed standard duvet on that basis. Genuine personalisation and other statutory exceptions must be assessed separately. The linked general withdrawal page gives the statutory seal-removal condition, but then also treats bedding, mattresses and slatted bases as covered merely because they cannot be resold untouched; the CJEU’s mattress judgment shows that inability to sell as new is not the legal test.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer buys a listed standard-size duvet online, receives it and gives clear notice of withdrawal after five days, without opening the packaging or removing any seal. Assuming no other statutory exception, hygiene classification alone does not defeat that withdrawal.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.context: The product offers listed standard sizes and model choices. Its product-specific withdrawal panel gives an unconditional exclusion. The footer links a general 14-day withdrawal notice with a seal-removal condition; this is qualifying counterevidence, but it contradicts rather than repeats the product-specific rule.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.scope: German consumer distance purchases of this standard product with any seal intact and no other exception. No finding about custom manufacture, used duvets, actual refusals or loss.

versions.quote: Dieses Produkt ist im Best Nature Shop ein Hygieneartikel und daher vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen.
versions.tr: This product is a hygiene item at Best Nature Shop and is therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal.

returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.claim: excludes period underwear from statutory withdrawal without requiring a removed hygiene seal.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.quote: Bitte beachte, dass unsere Period Panties, aus hygienischen Gründen, vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen sind und können nicht retourniert werden können.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.tr: Please note that, for hygiene reasons, our period panties are excluded from the right of withdrawal and cannot be returned.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.law: The quoted product rule excludes statutory withdrawal for the whole category. Article 16(e) and BGB § 312g(2) no. 3 require a suitable sealed product and removal of that seal after delivery. Even if a particular period product could qualify once unsealed, that cannot exclude an otherwise eligible return while its seal remains intact. This finding does not decide whether worn or unsealed period underwear can lawfully be excluded.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer orders the standard Shorty online and changes their mind after delivery. They notify withdrawal within five days and leave the product unused with any hygiene seal intact. Assuming no other exception, the product category alone does not remove the statutory right.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.context: The live period-underwear category FAQ repeats a blanket exclusion after purchase. By contrast, the product also advertises 14-day returns; the general terms’ section 11 gives a 14-day statutory withdrawal right and contains no category exclusion. Those broader rights are important counterevidence to the product-specific statement.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.scope: German consumer online purchases of standard period underwear with any hygiene seal intact, within the statutory period and with no other exception. Used or unsealed goods, goodwill extensions and defect remedies are outside this finding.

versions.quote: Bitte beachte, dass unsere Period Panties, aus hygienischen Gründen, vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen sind und können nicht retourniert werden können.
versions.tr: Please note that, for hygiene reasons, our period panties are excluded from the right of withdrawal and cannot be returned.

returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.src: Retoure — final FAQ on how long to return an order
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.claim: sets the return dispatch period at 14 days after receipt, although withdrawal starts a separate return period.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.quote: Du kannst deine Artikel ab Erhalt innerhalb von 14 Tagen zurücksenden
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.tr: You can send your items back within 14 days of receipt.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.law: A consumer can declare a timely statutory withdrawal near the end of the normal 14-day cooling-off period and then send the goods back without undue delay within the following 14 days. Espadrij’s returns FAQ instead measures the dispatch period from receipt. Its separate statutory notice gives the correct period after withdrawal; the finding concerns these contradictory customer instructions.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer receives ordinary, non-personalised shoes, declares withdrawal on day 13, and dispatches them on day 15. Assume the dispatch is without undue delay and within 14 days of that declaration. The statutory return deadline is met, although the FAQ’s period from receipt has ended.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.context: The Retoure page also labels the return period as 14 days from receipt in step 1. No longer voluntary period or express statutory-rights carve-out is stated there. The separately linked Widerrufsrecht notice correctly permits any unequivocal withdrawal declaration, makes its form optional, and gives 14 days from the declaration to dispatch the goods. It also permits lawful withholding of the refund pending goods or dispatch evidence. Those qualifications prevent an allegation that the shop provides no correct notice or necessarily refuses later returns.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.scope: German consumer distance purchases of ordinary goods subject to statutory withdrawal, with timely unequivocal notice and no statutory exception. Published instructions only; no actual rejection or loss established.

versions.quote: Du kannst deine Artikel ab Erhalt innerhalb von 14 Tagen zurücksenden
versions.tr: You can send your items back within 14 days of receipt.

returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.src: Widerrufsrecht — Folgen des Widerrufs, first sentence
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.claim: excludes delivery charges from the statutory withdrawal refund.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.quote: alle Zahlungen, die wir von Ihnen erhalten haben, ausschließlich der Lieferkosten
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.tr: all payments that we have received from you, excluding delivery costs
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.law: For withdrawal from the whole purchase, Article 13 and BGB § 357(2) require repayment of the cheapest standard outbound delivery charge. Espadrij’s statutory notice excludes delivery costs without limiting the exclusion to an express-delivery supplement. This is distinct from return postage, which may be borne by a properly informed consumer.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.example: Hypothetical: A consumer pays €60 for ordinary shoes and €5 for the shop’s cheapest standard delivery, then validly withdraws from the whole purchase. Assume no diminished value or other lawful deduction. The refund is €65, subject to the lawful goods-or-dispatch-evidence withholding rule. A blanket exclusion of delivery costs would instead describe €60. Return postage is separate.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.context: The words appear in the statutory notice, not merely an optional extended return policy. The surrounding sentence promises repayment within 14 days after receipt of withdrawal; later clauses correctly preserve the original payment method, allow withholding until goods or dispatch evidence, and say the customer bears direct return postage. None of those clauses narrows the outbound-delivery exclusion to supplementary express costs.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.scope: Whole-contract statutory withdrawal from an ordinary German consumer online goods purchase. Limited to standard outbound delivery already paid, not an optional delivery upgrade, partial returns, or the separate cost of sending goods back.

versions.quote: alle Zahlungen, die wir von Ihnen erhalten haben, ausschließlich der Lieferkosten
versions.tr: all payments that we have received from you, excluding delivery costs

returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.claim: announces a flat €5 deduction for returns lacking an outer carton and invoice copy.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.quote: Bei Rücksendungen ohne Umkarton und Rechnungskopie werden pauschal 5 € von der Rückerstattung als Aufwandspauschale als Beteiligung abgezogen.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.tr: For returns without an outer carton and an invoice copy, a flat €5 contribution to expenses is deducted from the refund.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.law: For an otherwise valid statutory withdrawal, administration and processing work does not justify a flat refund deduction. The quoted rule is not tied to actual diminished value caused by unnecessary handling. A missing invoice copy does not itself diminish the goods’ value. Lawful direct return postage and any properly established diminished-value claim remain separate.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer validly withdraws from an €80 ordinary footwear order. They return the unworn shoes in their intact retail shoebox, safely protected by a strong mailing bag, without a separate outer carton or paper invoice copy. The order is identifiable from the withdrawal email; assume no transport damage, diminished value or unpaid return postage. A €5 administration deduction would reduce the goods refund to €75 even though the statutory withdrawal permits no such flat fee.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.context: The linked policy is headed Widerrufsrecht, begins by pointing to a withdrawal form, and applies the fee under returns/exchanges without an express limitation to voluntary returns. Its German and English regular-return blocks state 14 days from purchase, a later English template gives 14 days after receipt to request a return, and an explicit EU 14-day cooling-off section recognises statutory withdrawal. A seasonal Christmas extension is also offered. The separately linked declaration page correctly says its form is optional. The narrow finding is the blanket administration-fee instruction as applied within statutory withdrawal, not conditions for a purely voluntary late exchange.
returns-coilex-flat-administration-fee.scope: Timely statutory withdrawal from ordinary German consumer online purchases with no exception, identifiable order, safe equivalent transit protection and no actual diminished value. No finding that every packaging cost is unlawful, or that the fee was actually charged.

versions.quote: Bei Rücksendungen ohne Umkarton und Rechnungskopie werden pauschal 5 € von der Rückerstattung als Aufwandspauschale als Beteiligung abgezogen.
versions.tr: For returns without an outer carton and an invoice copy, a flat €5 contribution to expenses is deducted from the refund.
